scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --parallel --filter "./apps/*" run dev
scripts.check:api: prettier --check apps/api packages "*.{json,mjs,yaml}" && pnpm --filter "@agentic-studio/api..." run check
scripts.test:api: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter "@agentic-studio/api..." --if-present run test
scripts.contracts:generate: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @agentic-studio/api run openapi:generate && pnpm --filter @agentic-studio/web run client:generate
